"Who does your hair?"

You get asked it. I know you do, because most of the people sitting in my
chair arrived because somebody answered that question with my name.

It's the kindest thing a client can do for me, and until now I've never
properly said thank you. So from today, that answer is worth something to
you, and to whoever you send my way.


THE THANK YOU

  You receive   15% off your next appointment
  They receive  10% off their first appointment


HOW IT WORKS

  01  You mention me to someone whose hair you'd like to see happy.
  02  They say your name when they book. That's the whole system.
  03  Once they've been in, your 15% is sitting on your file for next time.

No code. No link. No form. Just your name.


IF IT HELPS, BORROW MY WORDS

  "You should book in with Sha in Camberwell. She's who does my hair.
   Mention my name and you'll get 10% off your first visit."
